about_the_game:
Step into the neon-lit grounds of the Feria de Abril in the year 3000, where tradition and machine collide. You play as a fierce flamenco heroine tasked with defending your caseta from relentless waves of cybernetic invaders.

Key Features

  • Wave-based survival combat: Face escalating rounds of AI robots, each introducing new attack patterns and escalating difficulty.

  • Build & defend mechanics: Between rounds you spend collected pesetas to deploy turrets, place explosive barrels, and reinforce your defenses.

  • Precision shooting: Strategic headshots reward you with greater damage; mastering slow-motion jumps keeps you alive in the thick of battle.

  • Dynamic progression: Choose your path via the in-game shop—power-ups boost damage, defence, utilities, and unlock new tactical options.

  • Distinctive setting & style: A unique blend of Andalusian feria culture and cyber-punk warfare—lanterns, neon, flamenco rhythms collide with machine gun fire.

  • Music from Andalusian artists – A vibrant mix of flamenco guitars, electronic beats, and rumba rhythms created by diverse Andalusian musicians and producers.

  • Replayable experience: Each session lasts roughly 20-40 minutes depending on skill and build-choices, perfect for repeated runs to improve your score and defence strategy.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 7 2700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT / Intel Arc A580
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700 / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 / AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT / Intel Arc B580
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: A single-player third-person shooter with tower-defense mechanics set in a futuristic Andalusian fair. Defend your caseta at the Feria against endless robot waves. Place turrets, drop bombs, and get random power-ups between rounds.
